user_workflow: Step 1: Dashboard / Library view displays existing projects & map templates with initial Sample Demo Project pre-loaded.
Step 2: Create or select project -> Opens Tactical Editor workspace.
Step 3: Upload/Select Game Map image (e.g., Free Fire Bermuda, Purgatory, Kalahari, Alpine, PUBG Erangel, Miramar, Rondo). Map saved persistently in IndexedDB.

Step 4: Add reusable Esports Teams in Team Manager library (Team Name, Tag shortcode, Color, Logo Image URL/Upload). Pre-populated with sample esports teams (e.g., LOUD, Alpha7, Team Falcons, Nigma Galaxy, EVOS Esports).
Step 5: Select marker mode (Tag Marker vs Image-Logo Marker).
Step 6: Click on Map at specific POI/drop zone (e.g., Factory, Clock Tower, Peak, Pochinki, Military Base) to place drop spot.
Step 7: Assign 1 to 5 teams to the drop location. System automatically calculates geometric 1–5 team layout clusters (Radial offset, Grid split, Fan layout).
Step 8: Fine-tune markers manually via drag-and-drop. System dynamically draws tactical connector lines back to POI anchor point.
Step 9: Real-time IndexedDB/Local Storage autosave with visual 'Autosaved' HUD indicator.
Step 10: High-Resolution PNG Export with customizable watermark, map scale, tournament title, match/day details, and team summary card.

key_components_to_build.Navbar: Top navigation bar with project title edit, map switch dropdown, undo/redo, clear markers, autosave status badge, and Export PNG CTA.
key_components_to_build.MapLibraryModal: Modal/View to browse saved map templates, upload new game map images with scaling factor, or select standard presets.
key_components_to_build.TeamLibraryDrawer: Side panel to manage team roster, add/edit/delete teams, search teams, change brand color, upload/paste custom logo URL.
key_components_to_build.DropMarkerCanvas: Interactive HTML5 Canvas / SVG overlay rendering relative map coordinates (% x, % y), team marker clusters (1 to 5 layout shapes), connector lines, and drag handlers.
key_components_to_build.LayoutArranger: Automatic 1-5 team drop position generator: 1=Centered, 2=Side-by-side duo split, 3=Triangle fan, 4=Quad grid, 5=Pentagon star around POI.
key_components_to_build.MarkerPropertiesPanel: Right sidebar section to toggle marker style (Text Tag vs Logo Icon vs Full Badge), line thickness, connector line style (Dashed/Solid/Glow), scale size, label opacity.
key_components_to_build.ExportCanvasModal: High-res PNG generator with title header banner ('FREE FIRE WORLD SERIES 2026 - DROP MAP'), team roster footer legend, grid toggle, dark tactical frame.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.test_id_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='map-library-button', data-testid='team-add-input', data-testid='export-png-button').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.js_file_extension: Codebase uses standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files. Guidelines and components must match JS modules.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.header_background: Never use pure transparent header backgrounds; always apply glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-950/80.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_contrast: Always explicitly define hover text and background pairs (e.g., hover:bg-purple-600 hover:text-white).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure focus rings with ring-2 ring-purple-500 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-slate-950 for keyboard navigation.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.empty_states: Provide clear call-to-action tactical cards when no maps or teams are selected.
